title: Echo a Ɛduruu Ahengua no So
intro: Obi a ne ho ayɛ adesoa bɛn atɛntrenee akongua no, na ɛnyɛ ehu na wɔn nne rewosow na mmom anidaso. Ná asɛm no yɛ ankorankoro de, nanso na ne gyinaesi no bɛka bere tenten, na abubu atetesɛm bi a ɛhyɛ nkurɔfo so. Hena ne ɔkra yi a wɔtee n’anwiinwii wɔ nsoromma akyi no?
clues: Mede koma a emu yɛ duru bae, na mehwehwɛɛ atɛntrenee wɔ asɛm bi a ɛkyekyere me tɛkrɛma mu.
Ná m’adesrɛ no nyɛ ɔbɔfo bi kɛkɛ; ɛforo kɔɔ akyiri, kɔɔ Nea ɔte ne nyinaa nkyɛn.
Ná nsɛm a wɔka tiaa me no te sɛ tete bere bi a atwam mu nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn.
Mede nusu ne ntease gyee akyinnye na misusuw ho maa me nidi.
Adiyisɛm bi sian baa fam, na ɛmaa akwan dedaw no yɛɛ komm na gyee me yaw no toom.
Wɔfrɛ me sɛ nea ogyee me kunu ho akyinnye, na me din bɛyɛɛ nea ɛne ti a ɛmaa mede me ho no yɛɛ ade koro.

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
